title: Pressing before a fish bites
about: Spring 4, 10:00, on the farm pond bank facing the water with the rod in hand and a new game's 10 worms. Press Action to cast (the worms drop to 9), then tap the fishing sheet (or press Action) before anything bites: the bobber is pulled up the track, the sheet closes, the farmer reels the empty line in, "Too soon: line reeled in, bait kept." shows, and the worms are back at 10. QA item: "Puxar a vara se o usuário apertar antes de fisgar o peixe".
